ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light-gray) and 25% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity dark pigmentation is concentrated along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Significant dark mottling is present at the median notch base and scattered as discrete circular and irregular clusters across the central and lower-mid sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing edge; frequency increases significantly toward the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate sigmoidal curve; initial convexity from the notch, transitioning to a concave section in the middle lobe, ending in convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Rough, high-contrast textured pixel clusters consistent with barnacle growth at both lateral tips; scattered dark circular spots concentrated in the lower central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed as parallel diagonal lines on the lower left lobe and a curved horizontal mark on the middle right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical calcification and scarring at the extreme distal tips; multiple sets of linear rake marks across the light-pigmented ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark, comma-shaped pigmentation mark located in the interior mid-section of the right fluke lobe.
